$description: frontiers-brand's imagery pool (0014-design-systems FR-043; frontiers-brand FR-015): every approved piece of artwork a design system it themes may choose from, what each shows and can stand for, and its files. Which work uses which piece is that work's own record, never this file's. Checked by tools/brand_imagery.py check.

fields.id: stable slug, environment first and then the anchor; the master's file name without .png
fields.name: a short human name
fields.file: the master: <id>.png, the approved file byte for byte, with real transparency
fields.description: what is drawn, foreground to horizon
fields.visual_anchor: the one built thing the eye lands on
fields.route: how people move through the scene
fields.built_structures: every human-made thing in the scene
fields.infrastructure_type: the kind of system the structures form (bridge, railway, dam, observatory, ...)
fields.colored_elements: what carries color: human intervention, plus water when present
fields.metaphors: what the piece can stand for
fields.suggested_subjects: subjects the metaphors suit; a starting point, not a rule
fields.source: where the approved piece came from
fields.content_box: [left, top, right, bottom] pixel bounds of the drawn art (alpha > 16); a renderer that needs the art alone trims to it
fields.web: the master as WebP for the web, one file per width, each [file, width, height]; written by tools/brand_imagery.py build

pieces.name: Fog Coast Lighthouse and Footbridge
pieces.description: A lit lighthouse and red-roofed keeper's cottage stand on a forested headland above a surf-battered, fog-bound coast with sea stacks. A roped fence and trail climb from the foreground across a timber footbridge on a stone pier to the light.
pieces.visual_anchor: lighthouse on a fog-bound headland
pieces.route: roped foot trail crossing a timber footbridge up to the headland

water.form: ocean surf, sea stacks, and tide pools

metaphors: warning of hazards others cannot see

pieces.name: Glacier Lake Cairn Trail
pieces.description: A trail crosses a small timber footbridge over a cascading stream, passes a stone cairn topped with a red pennant, and climbs toward a hut on a rise. A glacier descends from the peaks behind into a blue lake.
pieces.visual_anchor: red-flagged cairn beside a trail below a glacier
pieces.route: foot trail over a footbridge, marked by a cairn and pennant, climbing to a hut
metaphors: marking the route for those who follow
leaving markers where others will need them

pieces.name: Volcanic Caldera Lookout
pieces.description: An observation lookout with an antenna mast stands on a rocky summit above a caldera lake, facing a smoking volcano. A fenced switchback trail with a signpost climbs from a timber footbridge over a cascading stream to the lookout.
pieces.visual_anchor: summit lookout facing a smoking volcano over a caldera lake
pieces.route: fenced switchback trail from a footbridge up to a summit lookout

pieces.name: River Gorge Rope Bridge
pieces.description: A trail with a signpost leads to a rope suspension footbridge slung across a whitewater river between granite walls and dark conifers. On the far bank a lit cabin sits above a small landing with steps down to the water.
pieces.visual_anchor: rope footbridge across a whitewater gorge
pieces.route: foot trail with a signpost, crossing the river on a rope suspension footbridge to a cabin
metaphors: crossing the gap between two banks
nobody falls between the two sides

pieces.name: Mountain Stream Watermill
pieces.description: A timber watermill with a turning wheel sits on a stone foundation where a mountain stream drops through falls. A footbridge crosses to it, a lantern post marks the approach, and a fenced trail zigzags up the forested slope toward snow peaks.
pieces.visual_anchor: watermill wheel turning beside mountain falls
pieces.route: fenced trail with a lantern post, crossing a footbridge to the mill, zigzagging up the slope behind

water.form: mountain stream and falls driving the wheel

metaphors: turning abundant natural force into steady useful work
a well-built machine that runs itself

pieces.name: Sea Cliff Lighthouse Trail
pieces.description: A lit lighthouse and keeper's house stand on a cliff above heavy surf and sea stacks. A fenced trail winds up the rocks from the foreground, crossing a timber footbridge on a stone pier.
pieces.visual_anchor: lighthouse on a sea cliff above breaking surf
pieces.route: fenced foot trail with a footbridge, winding up the cliff to the lighthouse

water.form: ocean with breaking waves and sea stacks

pieces.name: Desert Canyon Outpost
pieces.description: A trail with a blue-marked signpost crosses cactus and yucca country to an outpost on a canyon rim: timber buildings, a windmill, a water tower, a tethered horse. A river with small falls runs below; mesas and buttes stand beyond.
pieces.visual_anchor: windmill and water tower at a canyon-rim outpost
pieces.route: foot trail with a signpost, crossing desert scrub to the outpost on the rim
metaphors: building what you need where you are
the people on the ground equipping themselves
suggested_subjects: end users building their own tools

pieces.name: Cavern Survey Camp
pieces.description: Inside a vast limestone cavern, a lantern-lit stone stairway with a rope rail climbs to a ledge camp: a canvas tent, supply crates, a hanging lantern, and a survey instrument on a tripod. An underground river falls into a luminous pool beneath stalactites.
pieces.visual_anchor: lantern-lit survey camp inside a cavern
pieces.route: rope-railed stone stairway lit by lanterns, climbing to the camp ledge
metaphors: reducing uncertainty with light and measurement

pieces.name: Mountain Railway Trestle and Station
pieces.description: A steam train crosses a timber-and-iron trestle arch high over a waterfall gorge, leaving a mountain station with a signal flag and lantern. A fenced foot trail climbs from the foreground to the station platform.
pieces.visual_anchor: steam train on a trestle arch over a gorge
pieces.route: fenced foot trail up to the station; the railway crosses the gorge on a trestle arch
metaphors: a system that carries load across hard terrain
integration of many parts into one route

pieces.name: Canyon Suspension Bridge
pieces.description: A long timber suspension bridge with lanterns on its towers spans a deep desert canyon between two rims. A fenced trail leads onto it from the foreground; a lit cabin and pennant wait on the far rim; a river runs far below.
pieces.visual_anchor: suspension bridge spanning a desert canyon
pieces.route: fenced foot trail leading onto a suspension bridge across the canyon
metaphors: spanning a gap that looked impassable
linking two sides with no natural connection
the missing path from value to the one who pays

pieces.name: Coastal Road Tunnel and Arch Bridge
pieces.description: A cliffside road on a stone retaining wall runs from a lit tunnel portal straight across an iron arch bridge over a sea inlet studded with stacks. A stepped, fenced trail climbs to it past a small timber hut and lamps.
pieces.visual_anchor: road emerging from a tunnel onto an arch bridge over the sea
pieces.route: stepped fenced trail joining a road that runs through a tunnel and over an arch bridge
metaphors: going straight through rather than around
direct access to what you need

pieces.name: Cliffside Funicular
pieces.description: A red funicular car climbs a steep timber-trestle incline from a lit lower station beside a fenced trail to an upper station with a pennant on a cliff top. A tall waterfall drops through the gorge beside it.
pieces.visual_anchor: funicular car climbing a cliff beside a waterfall
pieces.route: fenced trail to a lower station; a funicular incline climbs directly to the top station
metaphors: a direct line from the ground floor to the top
access for those who used to be kept at the bottom

pieces.name: Alpine Cable Car Gorge
pieces.description: Red gondolas travel an aerial cableway across a deep river gorge between a lit mountain station on timber towers and a smaller station on the far cliffs. A fenced stepped trail climbs to the near station past a small hut.
pieces.visual_anchor: red gondolas crossing a gorge on a cableway
pieces.route: fenced stepped trail to a cableway station; gondolas cross the gorge overhead
metaphors: light, fast transit over terrain that once took days

pieces.name: Canyon Canal Locks and Aqueduct
pieces.description: A canal steps down a canyon wall through a flight of stone locks with timber gates and winch wheels, feeding an arched aqueduct across the gorge. A lockkeeper's stone house with a lantern post stands above; a fenced trail and stair follow the locks down.
pieces.visual_anchor: flight of canal locks descending into a canyon
pieces.route: fenced trail and stair following the flight of locks down the canyon wall
metaphors: moving between levels in controlled steps
stage gates built into the structure
governance done by the system itself

pieces.name: Mountain Pipeline Trestle
pieces.description: A red pipeline on timber trestles crosses a gorge from a mountain reservoir and waterfall to a lit pump house with a lamp tower and valves. A fenced trail climbs to the pump house through snow-dusted boulders and conifers.
pieces.visual_anchor: red pipeline on trestles crossing a gorge
pieces.route: fenced foot trail climbing to the pump house; the pipeline crosses the gorge on trestles
metaphors: flow through a long system where every leak matters

pieces.name: Mountain Telegraph Line
pieces.description: A line of telegraph poles with glass insulators and lanterns carries wires from a stone cabin down across a gorge and up the far ridge. A timber trestle bridge crosses the rapids beside the line; a trail descends from the cabin.
pieces.visual_anchor: telegraph line crossing a mountain gorge
pieces.route: foot trail from the cabin down to a trestle bridge; the telegraph line crosses the gorge and continues along the ridge
metaphors: a signal carried across wild terrain

pieces.name: Canyon Mine Headframe and Flume
pieces.description: A timber mine headframe with an ore bucket rises over mine buildings on a canyon ledge, fed by a water flume on tall trestles. A lantern-lit stairway trail climbs to it through desert scrub; ladders and a small hut cling to the cliff; a river runs below.
pieces.visual_anchor: mine headframe on a canyon ledge
pieces.route: lantern-lit stairway trail climbing to the mine; the flume carries water across the canyon
metaphors: finding value already in the ground

pieces.name: Mountain Dam and Sluice Gates
pieces.description: A masonry dam with timber sluice gates and winch wheels holds a mountain reservoir, releasing controlled torrents into the gorge below. A gatehouse with lamps stands at one end; a fenced stone stairway trail climbs to it.
pieces.visual_anchor: sluice gates releasing water from a mountain dam
pieces.route: fenced stone stairway trail climbing to the gatehouse and dam walkway
metaphors: holding a resource that already exists and releasing it deliberately
the operation that turns a supply into a yield

pieces.name: Alpine Lake Cabin and Dock
pieces.description: A log cabin with a smoking chimney sits above a deep alpine lake under a glaciated range. A fenced foot trail with a signpost winds down through boulders to the shore, where a small dock and rowboat wait; the lake spills out through a cascading stream in the foreground.
pieces.visual_anchor: red-roofed cabin above a still alpine lake
pieces.route: fenced foot trail with a signpost, winding from the foreground down to the cabin and lakeshore

water.form: alpine lake with a cascading outlet stream

metaphors: establishing a base at the edge of the known
a durable home in hard country

pieces.name: Canyon River Homestead
pieces.description: A fenced trail with a signpost descends a boulder-strewn canyon wall toward a homestead on a river bend: ranch house, barn, corral with horses, a covered wagon, and a timber gate arch. Sheer mesas and a long canyon recede behind it.
pieces.visual_anchor: homestead and corral on a river bend inside a deep canyon
pieces.route: fenced foot trail with a signpost, descending the canyon wall to the homestead

water.form: river winding through the canyon floor

metaphors: making a living in hard country
settling beside the resource that sustains you
the long way down to where the work happens

pieces.name: Badlands Ranch and Windmill
pieces.description: A wagon-rutted dirt road runs from an open timber gate across dry badlands to a ranch: house, windmill, water tank, fenced pasture with grazing horses. A pond and creek run beside the road; mesas and eroded bluffs fill the horizon.
pieces.visual_anchor: windmill and ranch house on open badlands
pieces.route: wagon-rutted dirt road through a gate, running across open country to the ranch

water.form: pond and creek beside the road

metaphors: the long road out to where the value is

pieces.name: Alpine Lakeshore Landing
pieces.description: A lakeside trail with a signpost leads past a cabin to a lantern-lit landing with a moored rowboat on a long alpine lake. Glaciated peaks rise across the water.
pieces.visual_anchor: lantern-lit landing on a long alpine lake
pieces.route: lakeshore foot trail with a signpost, ending at a cabin and landing
metaphors: the edge of a larger body you have not yet crossed

pieces.name: Old-Growth Forest Cabin
pieces.description: Among enormous old-growth trunks and ferns, a trail with a signpost crosses a timber footbridge over a stream below a waterfall and climbs to a lit cabin with a stone chimney on a rocky outcrop.
pieces.visual_anchor: cabin on an outcrop among giant trees
pieces.route: fenced foot trail with a signpost, crossing a footbridge and climbing to a cabin
metaphors: the scale and age of the system you enter
stewardship of something older than you

pieces.name: Gorge Railway Arch Bridge
pieces.description: A steam train crosses a red iron arch bridge on stone piers above a waterfall gorge, pulling away from a lit mountain station with a signal flag. A fenced trail curves up to the station through boulders and conifers.
pieces.visual_anchor: iron arch railway bridge over a waterfall gorge
pieces.route: fenced foot trail curving up to the station; the railway spans the gorge on an iron arch
metaphors: an engineered span over a hard gap

pieces.name: Canyon Aqueduct and Mill
pieces.description: A stone aqueduct on tall arches carries a water channel with timber sluice gates across a canyon to a stone mill house with a water wheel. A stone stairway trail with a fence climbs to the mill; a river runs through the gorge below; mesas beyond.
pieces.visual_anchor: arched stone aqueduct crossing a canyon
pieces.route: fenced stone stairway and trail climbing to the mill; the aqueduct carries water across the canyon
metaphors: carrying a resource across terrain to where it can be used
infrastructure that turns supply into value

pieces.name: Mountain Penstock and Powerhouse
pieces.description: A riveted penstock pipe runs down a forested slope on stone piers from a hillside intake to a lit powerhouse, whose tailrace arches release water into a rapid river. A fenced switchback trail descends beside it; a timber footbridge and utility poles lead away.
pieces.visual_anchor: penstock pipe descending to a riverside powerhouse
pieces.route: fenced switchback trail descending beside the penstock to the powerhouse
metaphors: converting a natural gradient into power

pieces.name: Coastal Causeway Lighthouse
pieces.description: A fenced stone causeway on arches, lit by lamp posts, runs across breaking surf and rocks to a lighthouse, keeper's house, and signal mast with flags on a rocky islet. Fogged sea cliffs and forest line the coast behind.
pieces.visual_anchor: lamp-lit causeway to a lighthouse islet
pieces.route: fenced causeway with lamp posts, crossing the surf to the lighthouse islet

water.form: ocean surf around a rocky islet

metaphors: a continuous safe path across broken ground

pieces.name: Mountain Road Tunnel and Viaduct
pieces.description: A fenced road climbs in switchbacks on massive stone retaining walls to a lit tunnel portal, while a stone viaduct crosses the gorge beside a waterfall. A small timber shelter with a lamp stands at the foot of the road.
pieces.visual_anchor: switchback road climbing to a tunnel beside a viaduct
pieces.route: fenced switchback road on retaining walls, entering a tunnel; a viaduct crosses the gorge
metaphors: an engineered route through impossible terrain
a sequence of hard problems solved in order
